ctx.x: I read, like, editorials by Fred Friendly and a million other people who are very well informed on television and everything that's been around the last 30, 40 years. And they realize we're headed for a big drop. The whole enter-
tainment scene, and it's because they're not allowing anything to surface other than what they dictate.
